settings.custom_liquid:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

  .po-pricing-luxury,
  .po-pricing-luxury * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury {
    --po-page-width: 1440px;

    --po-pink: #fcb6eb;
    --po-dark-green: #293f07;
    --po-green: #95ad4f;
    --po-orange: #ff960e;
    --po-purple: #927ec3;
    --po-white: #ffffff;

    --po-font-header-1: "Degular Demo Black", "Bricolage Grotesque", "Montserrat", sans-serif;
    --po-font-header-2: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Montserrat", sans-serif;
    --po-font-body: "Montserrat Classic", "Montserrat", Arial, sans-serif;

    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 96px 0;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 10% 8%, rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.18), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 88% 16%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.1), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.045), transparent 34%),
      var(--po-white);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 24px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.1);
    border-radius: 36px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury::after {
    content: "pricing";
    position: absolute;
    right: -18px;
    bottom: -16px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.045);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(76px, 11vw, 170px);
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 0.8;
    letter-spacing: -0.07em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__container {
    width: min(var(--po-page-width), calc(100% - 32px));
    margin: 0 auto;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__head {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 0.9fr) minmax(420px, 1.1fr);
    align-items: end;
    gap: 64px;
    margin-bottom: 34px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__eyebrow {
    width: fit-content;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.18);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    border: 1px solid rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.36);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__eyebrow::before {
    content: "";
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--po-orange);
    flex: 0 0 10px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__title {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 720px;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(44px, 5.2vw, 78px);
    line-height: 0.94;
    letter-spacing: -0.065em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__title .accent {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__intro {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 660px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.72);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
    font-size: clamp(16px, 1.35vw, 18px);
    line-height: 1.68;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__intro strong {
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-weight: 900;
  }  .po-pricing-luxury__cards {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 560px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    border-radius: 32px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1),
      0 22px 58px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.09);
    overflow: hidden;
    transition:
      transform 0.28s ease,
      box-shadow 0.28s ease,
      border-color 0.28s ease;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 24px;
    right: 24px;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--po-green), var(--po-orange));
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: center;
    transition: transform 0.28s ease;
    z-index: 3;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    border-color: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.55);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1),
      0 34px 82px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.15);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card:hover::after {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__image {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 190px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.14);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition:
      transform 0.45s ease,
      filter 0.45s ease;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card:hover .po-pricing-luxury__image img {
    transform: scale(1.06);
    filter: saturate(1.08) contrast(1.04);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__image::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.02), rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.22)),
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.14), transparent 34%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__content {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 24px 22px 24px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__tag {
    width: fit-content;
    min-height: 30px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 12px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.16);
    border: 1px solid rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.28);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card:nth-child(2n) .po-pricing-luxury__tag {
    background: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.13);
    border-color: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.24);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__card-title {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 29px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.052em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__desc {
    margin: 12px 0 0;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.68);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__starting {
    margin: 18px 0 0;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.62);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__price {
    margin: 10px 0 18px;
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: 42px;
    line-height: 0.95;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__price span {
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.58);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__section-label {
    margin: 0 0 12px;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0 0 18px;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 9px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__list li {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 20px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.72);
    font-family: var(--po-font-body);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__list li::before {
    content: "✓";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__examples {
    margin-top: auto;
    padding-top: 18px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.1);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__examples-title {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.56);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__examples p {
    margin: 0;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.68);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__experience {
    margin-top: 24px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.38fr) minmax(320px, 0.62fr);
    gap: 20px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.94fr) minmax(280px, 0.62fr);
    min-height: 470px;
    border-radius: 38px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 12% 12%, rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.16), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(145deg, var(--po-dark-green) 0%, #203405 58%, #172603 100%);
    color: var(--po-white);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 76px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.2);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    padding: 38px 36px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-image {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 470px;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-image::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.8), rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.08)),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18));
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-kicker {
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-title {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 620px;
    color: var(--po-white);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 62px);
    line-height: 0.94;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-title em {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-text {
    margin: 22px 0 0;
    max-width: 610px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
    font-size: 15.5px;
    line-height: 1.68;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-text strong {
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__benefit-grid {
    margin-top: 28px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__benefit {
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 750;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__benefit::before {
    content: "✓";
    width: 19px;
    height: 19px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--po-orange);
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 900;
    flex: 0 0 19px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-stack {
    display: grid;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 225px;
    border-radius: 34px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 22px 56px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.09);
    overflow: hidden;
    transition:
      transform 0.28s ease,
      box-shadow 0.28s ease,
      border-color 0.28s ease;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 72px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.14);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 132px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.12);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card-img img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card-body {
    padding: 22px 24px 24px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-2);
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.052em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__info-card p {
    margin: 0;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.72);
    font-size: 14.5px;
    line-height: 1.58;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout {
    margin-top: 20px;
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 0.75fr) minmax(360px, 1fr) minmax(260px, 0.48fr);
    gap: 26px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 34px;
    border-radius: 38px;
    background: var(--po-white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 22px 58px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.08);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    right: -70px;
    top: -80px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 150, 14, 0.12);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout h3 {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--po-dark-green);
    font-family: var(--po-font-header-1);
    font-size: clamp(34px, 3.7vw, 54px);
    line-height: 0.94;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-text {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    margin: 0 0 18px;
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.68);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.64;
    font-weight: 500;
    max-width: 460px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-list {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 9px;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-list span {
    min-height: 38px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    padding: 0 13px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(149, 173, 79, 0.2);
    color: rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.76);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-list span::before {
    content: "✓";
    color: var(--po-orange);
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-img {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    height: 210px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.12);
  }

  .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-img img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

  @media (max-width: 1120px) {
    .po-pricing-luxury {
      padding: 78px 0;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury::before,
    .po-pricing-luxury::after {
      display: none;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__head {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__title,
    .po-pricing-luxury__intro {
      max-width: 780px;
    }    .po-pricing-luxury__cards {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__card {
      min-height: 530px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__experience {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__info-stack {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-text {
      max-width: 720px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-img {
      height: 260px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 820px) {
    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      min-height: auto;
      border-radius: 28px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-image {
      order: -1;
      height: 260px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-image img {
      min-height: 260px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-image::after {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.05), rgba(41, 63, 7, 0.5));
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-content {
      padding: 28px 22px 26px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__benefit-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__info-stack {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__info-card {
      border-radius: 24px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout {
      border-radius: 28px;
      padding: 24px 20px;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-img {
      height: 210px;
      border-radius: 22px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .po-pricing-luxury {
      padding: 62px 0;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__container {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0 16px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__eyebrow {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__title {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 12vw, 52px);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__intro {
      font-size: 15.5px;
      line-height: 1.58;
    }    .po-pricing-luxury__cards {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__card {
      min-height: auto;
      border-radius: 24px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__image {
      height: 210px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__content {
      padding: 22px 20px 24px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__card-title {
      font-size: 27px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__price {
      font-size: 36px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__list li {
      font-size: 13.8px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-title {
      font-size: clamp(34px, 11vw, 46px);
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__subscription-text {
      font-size: 14.8px;
      line-height: 1.58;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__benefit {
      min-height: 42px;
      font-size: 12.8px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__info-card h3 {
      font-size: 26px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout h3 {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 10vw, 42px);
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-text {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      line-height: 1.58;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-list {
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .po-pricing-luxury__checkout-list span {
      min-height: 34px;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 0 11px;
    }
  }
